candidate_selection: All three training seeds must reach at least 0.99 file-held-out accuracy; choose the lowest validation loss without reading intent probes.
gates: Overall acceptable-route accuracy and exact single-label accuracy must both improve over v4.
Verified-code accuracy must improve by at least 4 of 12 and reach at least 8 of 12.
No other category may lose more than 1 of 12.
Only after all blind-intent gates pass may the executable lane run, and it must not decline.
decision_rule: Reject on the first failed stage; do not threshold-tune or compare alternate seeds on the blind probe.
provenance_note: These gates were declared in the active run before blind scoring and persisted after the run; the Git artifact alone is not proof of pre-registration.
reuse_policy: The v4 blind probe is now exposed. Do not tune a successor against it; author another isolated probe for a v6 attempt.
